title: Meeting Processing Status — NORA
description: Lifecycle states of a meeting's processing. Web/Desktop filter the listing by these values. Source of truth: services/api/src/main/java/br/com/nora/api/domain/meeting/ProcessingStatus.java.

x-notes.PENDING: Upload finished; NLP analysis has not started yet. A goal saved on a COMPLETED meeting sends it back to PENDING for reprocessing.
x-notes.PROCESSING: Worker NLP rodando. Bloqueia novo upload/edit.
x-notes.FAILED: The worker failed. The UI shows the reprocess button (POST /meetings/{id}/reprocess).
